asset.name: Draggable
asset.description: The direct-manipulation primitive with pointer capture, keyboard dragging, constraints, drag handles, cancellation, velocity reporting, position announcements, and overlay support.

requires.reason: Pointer capture, constraints, and velocity keep movement outside React rendering.
Position and outcome are announced through the one shared live region.
Active drag and target state live in the shared scoped store.
User-facing copy resolves through the adopting host locale bridge.

rationale: Keyboard dragging is part of the contract rather than an enhancement. A drag interaction reachable only by pointer excludes keyboard and switch users from an entire class of operation.
